mintAuthority.summary: D14 review 2026-10-03: verified ThUSD.setMinter(address) is onlyOwner and accepts an arbitrary replacement address; ThUSD.mint(address,uint256) checks only msg.sender == minter before _mint. The timelock owner can therefore replace the collateral-checking ThUSDMinter with a recipient-controlled minter without upgrading token code. A 172800-second delay does not constrain the replacement to collateral-backed issuance. Economic cap is unbounded, with an unbounded-adverse fallback; reconciliation remains unknown. The governing 4-of-6 Safe is not delayed on-chain token governance, so no D29 qualification is asserted.

controls.label: ThUSDMinter mint gate
controls.capDescription: Sole token-level minter; transfers USDC/USDT collateral for depositor-signed orders before minting, requiring normalized thUSD output not to exceed collateral input. No undercollateralization tolerance exists; signers may accept less output. Current maxMintPerBlock is 1000000000000 six-decimal units (1000000 thUSD). Caps, supported assets and destinations are changeable only by the timelock admin, not by this contract itself.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-09-30 at Ethereum block 26088438. Token implementation, owner and sole minter are unchanged; complete role replay/hasRole proves minter admin solely on the self-administered 172800-second timelock, MINTER_ROLE solely on the backend EOA and EMERGENCY_ROLE solely on Guardian. No deployer/EOA timelock admin or open executor remains. The operator Safe is unchanged 4-of-6 with no modules/guard. Depositors sign orders; the backend submits them. Current code transfers supported USDC/USDT collateral before supply creation and rejects normalized output above input with no tolerance. Economic cap is collateral-gated under methodology 9.32: every live native mint path requires collateral, no current privileged caller bypasses it, and every minter authorization, replacement or upgrade path is absent or delayed 172800 seconds (above 86400). Numeric caps remain admin-raiseable, but the separately satisfied collateral-gated definition intentionally takes the lower rung. Timelocked administration may replace logic/minter, add collateral or reduce delay: this is not immutable backing protection. The Ethereum OFT adapter only locks/unlocks existing thUSD and is not its minter. Cash Wallet 0xec417ccb6dd26868cca993a92f37217b1d4b3c2f is both mint/redeem destination, a 4-of-5 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules/guard; it is neither token owner nor minter and has no role on ThUSDMinter or timelock. Post-mint collateral management and the unnamed FCM belong to reserve/custody uncertainty, not unresolved native issuance controls, so both aggregate questions are removed. Reconciliation is unknown: the Sep 30 dashboard snapshot and June 22 protocol attestation establish no continuous or recurring cadence for deployed backing; atomic collateral transfer is not ongoing reconciliation. Supervision remains none under Theo terms section 11.B.i's explicit governmental registration/licensing disclaimer. MPC is issuer-attested, not chain-provable. No mint incident is disclosed in reviewed issuer security/audit evidence.
